subject: Anthrax
hook: ANTHRAX IS NOT WHAT YOU THINK
angle: The heavy metal band Anthrax was named after a disease found in a biology textbook by founding member Scott Ian, who chose the name simply because he thought it sounded "sufficiently evil."
angle_support: The band was named after the disease of the same name which Ian saw in a biology textbook, chosen because it sounded "sufficiently evil."
title: The Surprising Origin of the Band Name Anthrax
description: You might think a famous heavy metal band's name was carefully crafted for its sound. It actually came from a quick look through a science textbook.
narration: ANTHRAX IS NOT WHAT YOU THINK You likely picture a heavy metal group laboring for months over a title that captures their aggressive sound. In reality, the final decision was much faster and far less profound. In 1981, the name was discovered while casually flipping through a biology class textbook. A deadly infectious disease was spotted and the search stopped. Ignoring the medical science, the word was chosen simply because the term sounded sufficiently evil for a new New York thrash group. It was an instant, permanent match. A school science project accidentally created a heavy metal icon.
